Surprisal: $\surprisalf{x}$, $\surprisalf{\frac{a}{b}}^2$, $\surprisal_i$.

Divergence: $\kldivf{p}{q}$, $\kldivf{\frac{a}{b}}{q}^2$, $\kldiv_{\param_0}$.
